body:
Update offline fake-agy fixtures, unit/integration test expectations, and eval benchmarks for the post-November-30-2026 19-slug model catalog.

Objectives:
1. Update test/fixtures/fake-agy models output for offline testing.
2. Update model slug and sub-pool assertions in test/orchestrator-routing.test.mjs, test/review-arl.test.mjs, test/review.test.mjs, test/unit.test.mjs, test/scheduler.test.mjs, test/sync-models.test.mjs, test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs, test/agy.test.mjs, test/modernize-skill.test.mjs, evals/scenarios.mjs, evals/subsystem-bench.mjs, and evals/v13-enhancements-bench.mjs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Orchestrator, review ARL, unit, scheduler, agy, modernize, evals, and sync-models tests pass offline. Verify: node --test test/orchestrator-routing.test.mjs test/review-arl.test.mjs test/review.test.mjs test/unit.test.mjs test/sync-models.test.mjs test/evals.test.mjs test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs test/agy.test.mjs test/modernize-skill.test.mjs test/scheduler.test.mjs
title: Align test fixtures, test suite, and eval benchmarks with post-Nov-30 catalog
